title: Tall building wireframe analysis (branch 1 of the systems demo)
description_for_llm: Linear elastic (Theory I) analysis of a tall building wireframe. The original example compares four lateral systems side by side; the harness feeds ALMOND_IN_LINES into the FIRST branch and disables the other three (their internal parametric towers exceed the Karamba trial's 20-beam cap on every solve). Loads: the branch's internal gravity load remains; its lateral point loads reference the original parametric geometry and may go inert with external lines, so treat results as gravity-dominated. No load input port. Keep member sets at or under 20 elements on a trial license - validate per frame line or use a licensed Karamba for full towers. HARNESSED 2026-08-30 from 01_HighRiseSystems.ghx. VERIFIED 2026-08-30: 1-story 6x6 m wireframe (8 lines, 4 fixed bases) -> disp 0.85 mm under the template gravity case, mass 10585 kg (the demo's heavy tower sections). Branch-0's original lateral loads reference internal geometry and are replaced by a clean gravity load in the harness. TRIAL NOTE: 16 input lines produced 32 model elements - keep inputs to about 8-10 lines on a trial license.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_LINES
inputs.description: Tower wireframe member axis lines (columns, beams, braces), node-merged at shared endpoints.

inputs.name: ALMOND_IN_SUPPORTS
inputs.description: Support node positions. When omitted the validator supplies the lowest-Z nodes of the input members automatically.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_DISP_MM
outputs.description: Largest nodal displacement; Karamba emits centimetres, converted downstream per these units.

outputs.name: ALMOND_OUT_MASS_KG
outputs.description: Total structural mass of the model.
